title: Reconcile icon-button tactile rhythm and deferred-progress semantics
creator: Ava Chen
description: Problem summary: multiple regressions and inconsistent behaviors have appeared across icon-only and compact action buttons after the token migration. Observed issues include: touch-target jitter on low-DPI mobile, spinner/outline flicker when users toggle theme during an in-flight action, and ambiguous cancellation affordances for deferred progress (long-running requests). Root cause analysis points to: (1) token boundary collisions between brand/ghost color sets causing rapid repaint when theme variables are interpolated; (2) press-scale animation timing that conflicts with the spinner fade-in (spinner appears before press settle causing perceived jitter); (3) missing explicit cancel affordance and ARIA mapping for icon buttons showing progress. Goal: define a coherent interaction contract for icon buttons under load, update token fallback rules to prevent theme-toggle repaint flicker, introduce a cancelable/deferred-progress visual pattern, and provide a deterministic QA checklist and regression harness for engineering.
acceptance_criteria: Icon-only and compact action buttons have consistent 44px hit target on mobile and 32px visual tap area while preserving layout in compact contexts
Press animation (scale/opacity) completes before spinner fade-in in >95% of simulated latency scenarios (0-3s) based on unit test harness
Theme toggle during in-flight requests does not produce outline/spinner color flicker in Chrome and WebKit on desktop and Android WebView
Deferred-progress pattern includes explicit cancel affordance (escape/secondary tap) and ARIA-live message for screen readers
Design tokens specify an unambiguous fallback path for icon button fills and outlines to avoid nearest-variable interpolation during runtime theme swaps
Automated visual regression tests added to Percy/Chromatic and pass for dark/light/high-contrast themes
Design handoff artifacts (Figma + interaction spec) and an engineering implementation checklist are attached and approved by QE and ENG leads
implementation_notes: Introduce token: button.icon.pressScale (default 0.96) and button.icon.pressDuration (120ms) and require spinner delay of min(pressDuration, 80ms) before fade-in
Spawn a lightweight cancel affordance state: 'deferred' with aria-label='Cancel action' and secondary tap mapping for icon buttons
Avoid CSS custom-property interpolation for critical color pairs used during theme swaps; use computed CSS classes during toggle to prevent intermediate values
Respect prefers-reduced-motion: spinner uses crossfade instead of scale when motion reduction is requested
Add RTL verification for icon offset and spinner alignment; ensure icon visual center aligns at 50% of the component box independent of LTR/RTL
Add unit tests that simulate theme toggle mid-request and assert no intermediate repaint using a deterministic color swap strategy (class toggle + requestAnimationFrame guard)
